name: cctv
short: Two live Pixel Agents office pages on one listener.
description: Owns the Discord guild projection, registered-agent editor projection, WebSocket listener, Dashboard pages, display policy, and activity clear timing for both CCTV views.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild display settings. Through corridor's office-state store, it also persists Discord user IDs and registered agent IDs that have avatar appearance or seat assignments.
install_msg: Install corridor and pixelagents too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor pixelagents); both load automatically. Starts an aiohttp HTTP/WebSocket listener (127.0.0.1:3210 by default; [p]cctv host/port) that serves the office webview to browsers. Setup: install Red Web Dashboard for the pages (/third-party/cctv), route /cctv/office/<server id>/ws and /cctv/editor/ws to the listener through a reverse proxy, set [p]cctv publicurl, then [p]cctv enable in a server. Offices are public by default ([p]cctv visibility). Showing offline members and presences needs the members and presences gateway intents. Character links point at Pixel Index's designer ([p]cctv designer).
author: Tin Nguyen
